Quick technical note on the canary vs rollback decision:
- Canary (preferred): split 5% traffic for 72 hours; KV-cache tuning + tokenization patch reduces tail from 720ms -> ~430ms median for long sessions. Infra estimate: 1 additional p3-equivalent for 3 days to absorb regen spikes, plus an ops oncall window for the roll. See canary-plan.xlsx for steps and rollback markers.
- Rollback (riskier): full rollback to 2.0 would resolve tail latency immediately, but would lose the new decoding improvements. Also requires a short freeze and revalidation (~4h) which impacts release schedule.

I can have a runnable canary playbook and resource estimate by Mon 2026-08-24 12:00. If Product decides rollback, we need sign-off by EOD Mon.

Karthik
Staff SW Eng, Inference Runtime
